# Flooded.com

> 24/7 emergency restoration services for water, fire, mold, and sewage damage across New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut with 30-minute response times.

Flooded.com is a comprehensive disaster restoration company serving the Northeast since 1975, offering residential and commercial restoration services with certified experts and insurance claim support. The platform covers emergency response, property remediation, and full reconstruction services across multiple service areas.

## Key Topics

- Water damage restoration
- Fire & smoke damage
- Mold remediation
- Emergency response (24/7)
- Sewage cleanup
- Commercial restoration
- Insurance claims support
- New York service area
- New Jersey service area
- Property reconstruction
- HVAC cleaning
- Soot removal
- Odor elimination
- Residential restoration
- Storm damage

## Core Services

- [Water Damage Restoration Services](https://flooded.com/our-services/water-damage-restoration): Water damage restoration: extraction, drying, repairs with insurance support
- [Fire & Smoke Damage Restoration](https://flooded.com/our-services/fire-smoke-damage-restoration): Fire & smoke damage restoration: cleanup, odor removal, soot remediation
- [Mold Remediation Services](https://flooded.com/our-services/mold-remediation): Mold remediation: inspection, safe removal, HVAC cleaning, 24/7 service
- [Sewage Damage Cleanup Services](https://flooded.com/our-services/sewage-damage-cleanup): Sewage cleanup: Category 3 water removal, sanitization, contamination cleanup
- [Reconstruction Services](https://flooded.com/our-services/reconstruction-services): Reconstruction services: rebuilding after water, fire, mold damage

## Commercial Restoration

- [Commercial Restoration Services](https://flooded.com/our-services/commercial-restoration-services): Commercial restoration: water, fire, structural damage for businesses
- [Commercial Water Damage Restoration](https://flooded.com/our-services/commercial-water-damage-restoration): Commercial water damage restoration with mold prevention and business recovery
- [Commercial Fire Damage Restoration](https://flooded.com/our-services/commercial-fire-damage-restoration): Commercial fire damage: odor elimination, soot removal, business restoration
